dog.description_text:
👑 Meet Princess! 👑

Princess is a medium-sized cutie who has been friendly with shelter staff. She's looking for an experienced adopter who can appreciate her for who she is while understanding that she may need some extra support to feel safe and comfortable in a home.

Princess has a history of anxiety and resource guarding in her previous home, so she'll need a patient, knowledgeable owner who is prepared to manage these challenges and help set her up for success. A home that prioritizes structure, positive reinforcement, mental enrichment, and physical exercise will be important for her well-being.

Princess may not be the right fit for every home, but for an experienced adopter who understands her needs and is committed to helping her navigate the world, she deserves a chance to find the right match. 💕
dog.name: Princess
